collection: The Original Three — reference clay models
notes: Closer interpretation of the cover and real clay trio supplied by the user.
Brown-gray tall cat ghost, squat blue blob, wide red-orange ghost.
Oversized cream eyes with irregular dark crescents; simple mouths; no fangs.
Embedded materials and geometry. Static meshes, +Y up, +Z front, base-center pivots.
These are modeled interpretations, not photogrammetry scans or exact replicas.

characters.name: Moss
characters.title: The tall brown-gray cat ghost
characters.description: The tall brown-gray figure from your original trio: soft cat ears, a long pear-shaped clay body, enormous cream button eyes, and a quiet pressed-in smile.

characters.name: Blu
characters.title: The curious blue blob
characters.description: The squat blue ghost from your cover: a broad puddled base, tiny uneven ear nubs, huge cream eyes, and a small open mouth. Rounded, awkward, and handmade.

characters.name: Ember
characters.title: The wide red-orange ghost
characters.description: The red-orange misfit from your cover: a wide sloping base, one rounded head bump, one little side point, and a lopsided open smile beneath wandering cream eyes.
